mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 64 degrees and a New Moon in the sky.
The Verona Common Council has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth, and the city continues to maintain a strong Moody's Aa1 rating.
Today, you can enjoy live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.
In a notable incident on October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was found to be a felon in possession of a firearm following a traffic stop.
Today's flavor is Caramel Cashew, and the Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM.
